title: Kick like Jeshurum
html_source:
Jeshurum is a poetic name for Israel used in the Hebrew Bible (albeit only four times). One of those times is the following:
‘But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; you grew fat, you grew thick’. (Deuteronomy 32:15)
